doc.title: Lee Simpson (founder of Jefferson City Buzzards) Interview, 1948-06-09
doc.interviewee: Lee Simpson (founder of Jefferson City Buzzards)

title: Closing thanks
summary: Wiley thanks Simpson and Simpson says goodbye to the brothers.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well, Mr. Simpson, it's been a great deal of pleasure to all of us to have you here tonight, and I'm sure this record that's been made will be appreciated by many future members. Good night.

Well, brothers, I'm happy to be with you tonight, and it's more than a pleasure to you to give any information, whatever I can remember, concerning the club. And if I've made any mistake, it's not my fault. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
